note: Ps37 (wisdom acrostic) - FIRST corrected-method read. Screen 0 applied: human IB dispositions + the two moral conditions (rasha/tsaddiq, each occurrence a distinct facet) = characteristics; 13 God-acts (laughs/knows/loves/upholds/exalts/saves...) = QUALIFIERS, each source-linked (D3, ve_nr 103) to the IB char it grounds - never standalone. Poetic ledger; span-id pairs; role write-back read-2026.

dims.v: 'FRET not (charah) yourself because of evildoers' — the psalm's opening command against the inner heat of vexation at the wicked's success; charah = to burn/be inflamed, the agitation the whole psalm dismantles (recurs v7,8)
'be not ENVIOUS (qana) of wrongdoers' — the covetous resentment of the wicked's prosperity, twinned with fretting; qana = the jealous longing the righteous must not feel toward the flourishing evil
'TRUST (batach) in the LORD, and do good' — reliance as the positive replacement for fretting; batach (recurs v5) the settled confidence that grounds the whole ethic of the psalm
'and DO GOOD (tov)' — active goodness joined to trust; tov here the practised good that accompanies faith (recurs v27 'turn from evil and do good')

'dwell in the land and befriend FAITHFULNESS (emunah)' — faithfulness as a practice to feed on / cultivate; emunah here the human's steady fidelity, the disposition to be nourished by (not God's faithfulness but the reader's own to be grown)
its fruit is the heart's desires granted

'DELIGHT (anag) yourself in the LORD, and he will give you the desires of your heart' — luxuriating/taking exquisite pleasure in God; anag = to be soft/take delight, the disposition whose fruit is the reshaped desires of the heart (recurs v11 of the meek)
whose desires are granted through delight
'the desires of your HEART (lev)' — the heart whose longings God fulfils for the one who delights in him; lev the seat of desire, reshaped and satisfied by delight in the LORD
trust (batach - commit your way and trust)
'Commit your way to the LORD; TRUST (batach) in him, and he will act' — rolling one's whole course onto God; batach (recurs v3) the trust that hands over the way and rests in God's acting

'He will bring forth your RIGHTEOUSNESS (tsedeq) as the light' — the reader's own righteousness, hidden now, to be displayed by God as noonday; tsedeq here the human's vindicated integrity (God's bringing-forth is its qualifier)
the one who prospers by evil devices
deprecated ('FRET NOT over the one who prospers')

'Be still before the LORD and wait patiently; FRET not (charah) over the one who prospers' — the second fret-command, set against stillness and patient waiting; charah the vexation the waiting soul renounces
the fretted-over prosperer carries them out
'the man who carries out EVIL DEVICES (mezimmah)' — the wicked's successful scheming; mezimmah (recurs Ps21:11) the crafty plans whose prosperity tempts the righteous to fret
'Refrain from ANGER (aph), and forsake wrath!' — here aph is the READER's anger (not God's) to be renounced; the inner heat that 'tends only to evil', the fret matured into rage
'and FORSAKE (azab) wrath!' — the deliberate release of rage; azab here the good abandoning (of one's own wrath), the act of letting anger go
'forsake WRATH (chemah)' — the burning heat of the reader's rage to be abandoned; chemah = hot fury, the intensified anger the righteous lets go lest it breed evil
deprecated ('FRET NOT; it tends only to evil')
'FRET not (charah); it tends only to evil' — the third fret-command with its reason: fretting itself breeds wrongdoing; charah the vexation exposed as a seedbed of evil, not a harmless mood
those who wait for the LORD
'those who WAIT (qavah) for the LORD shall inherit the land' — patient waiting as the mark of the heirs; qavah (recurs v34) the expectant hope opposed to fretting, rewarded with the inheritance

'In a little while, the WICKED (rasha) will be no more' — the wicked in their transience; rasha here the moral condition marked by its impermanence, gone when one looks for its place (facet: the vanishing wicked)

'though you LOOK carefully (bin) at his place, he will not be there' — discerning contemplation of the wicked's disappearance; bin = to consider/perceive, the reflective looking that confirms the wicked's end

'But the MEEK (anav) shall inherit the land' — meekness as the disposition of the heirs; anav (recurs Ps25:9, 34:2) the humble/lowly, the opposite of the fretting envier, delighting in peace (cited by Jesus, Mt5:5)
'and DELIGHT (anag) themselves in abundant peace' — the meek's luxuriating in peace; anag (recurs v4, there in the LORD) here in the shalom that is the meek's inheritance
'abundant PEACE (shalom)' — the fullness of well-being the meek enjoy; shalom (recurs v37 'man of peace') the inner and outer wholeness that is the heir's delight

'The WICKED (rasha) plots against the righteous and gnashes his teeth' — the wicked as active plotter; rasha here the condition expressed in scheming malice and teeth-gnashing rage (facet: the plotting wicked)
'PLOTS (zamam) against the righteous' — the calculated scheming of the wicked; zamam (recurs Ps31:13) the fixed evil intent against the just, which God only laughs at (v13)
secured by God's laughing at the wicked (v13)
the target of the wicked's plot

'the RIGHTEOUS (tsaddiq)' plotted against — the just one as object of malice; tsaddiq here the righteous condition under threat, secured because the LORD laughs at the plotter (v13, its qualifier-source)

v13 QUALIFIER (God's act, screened out as arena): 'the LORD LAUGHS (sachaq) at the wicked, for he sees his day is coming' — God's derision of the plotter is not a human IB characteristic; it is the SOURCE grounding the righteous's security (v12) and the reader's freedom from fret — captured here as a qualifier, never standalone.
'The WICKED (rasha) draw the sword... to bring down the poor and needy' — the wicked as violent predator; rasha here the condition expressed in armed assault on the weak (facet: the violent wicked)
'to bring down the POOR (ani) and needy' — the afflicted as prey of the wicked; ani (recurs Ps35:10) the lowly the wicked's sword targets, whose way is upright
'the poor and NEEDY (evyon)' — the destitute prey; evyon (recurs Ps35:10) the beggar-poor, paired with ani as the wicked's intended victims
'those whose way is UPRIGHT (yashar)' — the straight-walking whom the wicked would slay; yashar (recurs v37) the uprightness that marks the wicked's victims

'their sword shall enter their own HEART (lev)' — the wicked's violence recoiling on their own inner seat; lev here the wicked's heart, pierced by the very sword they drew (v14), the boomerang of malice
good / better (tov - the little of the righteous)

'BETTER (tov) is the little that the righteous has than the abundance of many wicked' — the wisdom-valuation that reorders desire; tov here the judgment that the righteous's little outweighs the wicked's much, curing envy (v1)
'the little that the RIGHTEOUS (tsaddiq) has' — the just one content with little; tsaddiq here the condition marked by sufficiency in modest means (facet: the content righteous)

'the abundance of many WICKED (rasha)' — the wicked in their prosperity; rasha here the condition of abundant wealth that is nonetheless worth less than the righteous's little (facet: the affluent wicked)
'the arms of the WICKED (rasha) shall be broken' — the wicked's strength shattered; rasha here the condition whose power is broken while the righteous is upheld (facet: the broken wicked)
'but the LORD upholds the RIGHTEOUS (tsaddiq)' — the just one sustained; tsaddiq here the condition secured by God's upholding (which is the qualifier-source), the counterpart to the broken wicked

v18 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'the LORD KNOWS (yada) the days of the blameless, and their heritage will remain forever' — God's knowing is not a human IB char; it is the SOURCE grounding the blameless's secure, enduring heritage — captured as a qualifier of tamim (v18).
secured by God's knowing their days (v18)

'the LORD knows the days of the BLAMELESS (tamim)' — the whole-hearted whose heritage endures; tamim (recurs Ps18:23) the integrity God watches over, its security grounded in God's knowing (v18 qualifier)
negated ('NOT put to shame in evil times')
'they are not put to SHAME (bosh) in evil times' — the blameless spared disgrace when calamity comes; bosh negated, the security of the righteous through evil times and famine
'in the days of famine they have ABUNDANCE (saba)' — the righteous satisfied when others starve; saba (recurs Ps17:15) here the God-given sufficiency of the blameless in famine
'But the WICKED (rasha) will perish... vanish like smoke' — the wicked in their evaporation; rasha here the condition destined to dissolve like smoke (facet: the perishing wicked)
'The WICKED (rasha) borrows but does not pay back' — the wicked as defaulter; rasha here the condition of grasping dishonesty, set against the giving righteous (facet: the defaulting wicked)
'but the RIGHTEOUS (tsaddiq) is generous and gives' — the just one marked by open-handedness; tsaddiq here the condition expressed in generosity (facet: the giving righteous)
'is GENEROUS (chanan) and gives' — gracious giving as the righteous's habit; chanan (recurs v26; usually 'be gracious') here the open-handed generosity that flows from righteousness
grounds the inheriting of the land (v22)

v22 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'those BLESSED (barak) by the LORD shall inherit the land, but those cursed by him cut off' — God's blessing/cursing is not a human IB char; it is the SOURCE determining who inherits — captured as a qualifier of the inheriting (the meek/righteous heirs, v11,29).
delight in (chaphets - God delights in the man's way)

v23 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'The steps of a man are established by the LORD, when he DELIGHTS (chaphets) in his way' — God's delight in the man's way is not a human IB char; it is the SOURCE that establishes the man's steps and upholds him when he falls (v24) — captured as a qualifier of the man's secured walk.

'I have not seen the RIGHTEOUS (tsaddiq) forsaken or his children begging' — the just one's lifelong provision; tsaddiq here the condition never abandoned, its security grounded in God's not-forsaking (v25 qualifier) (facet: the provided-for righteous)

v25 QUALIFIER (God's act, negated): the righteous never seen 'FORSAKEN (azab)' — God's not-forsaking is the SOURCE grounding the righteous's lifelong provision, not a human IB char — captured as a qualifier of tsaddiq (v25).
'He is ever lending GENEROUSLY (chanan)' — habitual open-handedness; chanan (recurs v21) the continual gracious giving of the righteous, whose children become a blessing

'Turn away from EVIL (ra) and do good; so shall you dwell forever' — the double command of the wise; ra (recurs Ps34:14 identically) the evil forsaken, matched by active good, the way of enduring dwelling
'and DO GOOD (tov)' — the positive command matching the turn from evil; tov (recurs v3) the active good that secures perpetual dwelling

v28 QUALIFIER (God's attribute): 'For the LORD LOVES (aheb) justice; he will not forsake his saints' — God's love of justice is not a human IB char; it is the SOURCE grounding the saints' being preserved forever — captured as a qualifier of chasid (v28).

v28 QUALIFIER (God's act, negated): 'he will not FORSAKE (azab) his saints' — God's not-forsaking is the SOURCE of the saints' eternal preservation, not a human IB char — captured as a qualifier of chasid (v28).
preserved because God loves justice + won't forsake (v28)

'he will not forsake his SAINTS (chasid). They are preserved forever' — the covenant-loyal kept safe; chasid (recurs Ps30:4, 31:23) the godly whose eternal preservation is grounded in God's love of justice and faithfulness (v28 qualifiers)

'the children of the WICKED (rasha) shall be cut off' — the wicked's line ended; rasha here the condition whose posterity is severed, contrasted with the saints preserved forever (facet: the cut-off wicked)

'The RIGHTEOUS (tsaddiq) shall inherit the land and dwell upon it forever' — the just as everlasting heirs; tsaddiq here the condition rewarded with perpetual inheritance (the refrain of v9,11,22,29,34) (facet: the inheriting righteous)

'The mouth of the RIGHTEOUS (tsaddiq) utters wisdom' — the just one's wise speech; tsaddiq here the condition expressed in a mouth of wisdom and a tongue of justice (facet: the wise-speaking righteous)
'UTTERS (hagah) wisdom' — the meditative speech of the righteous; hagah (recurs Ps1:2 meditate, 35:28) here the low utterance of wisdom, the overflow of the meditated law (v31)
'utters WISDOM (chokmah)' — the wisdom the righteous speaks; chokmah here the skilled moral understanding that fills the righteous's mouth, rooted in the law in his heart (v31)
heart (lev - the law in his heart)

'The law of his God is in his HEART (lev); his steps do not slip' — the internalised law securing the walk; lev here the seat where God's law is lodged, the inner ground of the righteous's sure steps (cf Ps40:8)
'The WICKED (rasha) watches for the righteous and seeks to put him to death' — the wicked as murderous stalker; rasha here the condition expressed in lethal watching (facet: the murderous wicked)
kept because God won't abandon him (v33)
the target of the wicked's watching
'the RIGHTEOUS (tsaddiq)' stalked to death — the just one hunted; tsaddiq here the condition under lethal threat, kept because God will not abandon him at trial (v33, its qualifier-source)
grounds the righteous's deliverance at trial (v33)

v33 QUALIFIER (God's act, negated): 'The LORD will not ABANDON (azab) him to his power or let him be condemned when brought to trial' — God's not-abandoning is the SOURCE keeping the righteous safe from the stalker, not a human IB char — captured as a qualifier of tsaddiq (v32).
condemn (rasha hiphil - God won't let, negated)

v33 QUALIFIER (God's judicial act, negated): God will not let the righteous 'be CONDEMNED (rasha) when brought to trial' — God's non-condemnation is the SOURCE of the righteous's acquittal, not a human IB char — captured as a qualifier of tsaddiq (v32).
rewarded by God's exalting to inherit (v34)

'WAIT (qavah) for the LORD and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit' — the disciplined hope with its reward; qavah (recurs v9) the patient waiting God crowns with exaltation and inheritance (God's exalting = its qualifier)

v34 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'he will EXALT (rum) you to inherit the land' — God's exalting is not a human IB char; it is the SOURCE/reward that crowns the reader's waiting (v34) — captured as a qualifier of qavah (v34).

'you will look on when the WICKED (rasha) are cut off' — the wicked seen in their end by the waiting righteous; rasha here the condition whose cutting-off the patient one witnesses (facet: the cut-off wicked)

'I have seen a WICKED (rasha), ruthless man, spreading himself like a green laurel' — the flourishing wicked observed; rasha here the condition seen at its lush height before it vanishes (v36) (facet: the flourishing-then-gone wicked)
'a wicked, RUTHLESS (arits) man' — the terror-inspiring violence of the wicked; arits = ruthless/tyrannical, the intimidating cruelty that yet passes away and is not found
'Mark the BLAMELESS (tam) and behold the upright' — the whole/complete man commended for observation; tam (recurs Ps37:18 tamim) the integrity whose end is a future of peace
paired with the blameless; issues in peace
'behold the UPRIGHT (yashar), for there is a future for the man of peace' — the straight one whose end is peace; yashar (recurs v14) the uprightness rewarded with a posterity/future
'a future for the man of PEACE (shalom)' — peace as the mark and reward of the blameless; shalom (recurs v11) the wholeness whose possessor has a future, unlike the cut-off wicked (v38)
paired with the wicked's cut-off future
'But TRANSGRESSORS (pasha) shall be altogether destroyed' — the rebels' total end; pasha (the verb of pesha, Ps32) the covenant-breakers whose future is cut off, the dark foil to the man of peace

'the future of the WICKED (rasha) shall be cut off' — the wicked with no posterity; rasha here the condition whose future is severed, sealing the psalm's contrast with the man of peace (facet: the futureless wicked)
their salvation is from the LORD (v39)

'The salvation of the RIGHTEOUS (tsaddiq) is from the LORD; he is their stronghold in trouble' — the just secured in God; tsaddiq here the condition whose salvation and stronghold is the LORD (v39 salvation = its qualifier-source) (facet: the God-saved righteous)

v39 QUALIFIER (God's provision): 'The SALVATION (teshuah) of the righteous is from the LORD' — salvation as God's is not a human IB char; it is the SOURCE that is the righteous's stronghold in trouble — captured as a qualifier of tsaddiq (v39).
wicked (rasha - the refuge-taker delivered from them)
those from whom the refuge-taker is delivered
'he delivers them from the WICKED (rasha)' — the wicked as that from which the refuge-taker is saved; rasha here the condition the trusting are rescued from (facet: the wicked as danger escaped)

'he saves them, because they TAKE REFUGE (chasah) in him' — the sheltering that is the psalm's final human disposition; chasah (recurs Ps34:8,22, 31:1) the refuge-taking that draws God's help and salvation (v40 helps/saves = its qualifiers) — the whole psalm's counsel distilled: not fret, but take refuge

v40 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'The LORD HELPS (azar) them and delivers them' — God's helping is not a human IB char; it is the SOURCE that answers and grounds the refuge-taking — captured as a qualifier of chasah (v40).

v40 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'he SAVES (yasha) them, because they take refuge in him' — God's saving is not a human IB char; it is the SOURCE that rewards the refuge-taking — captured as a qualifier of chasah (v40).

v15: 'their bows shall be BROKEN (shabar)' - physical outcome of the wicked's violence recoiling; not a human IB operation (the wicked's own heart-piercing sword is the IB finding, 277627). Standalone.
v17: 'the arms of the wicked shall be BROKEN (shabar)' - physical shattering of the wicked's strength; the IB finding is the wicked/righteous condition (277638/277642). Standalone.

v19: 'not put to shame in EVIL TIMES (ra)' - ra here the calamitous circumstance (times of trouble/famine) through which the blameless are kept, not an inner operation; the IB finding is the blameless's shame-free security (277651). Standalone/circumstance.
v26: 'his children become a BLESSING (berakah)' - the outcome of the righteous's generosity (the IB finding is generosity, 277712), not itself an inner operation. Standalone/outcome.

v2: 'they will soon fade like the grass and WITHER (nabel) like the green herb' - the wicked's transience imaged in withering grass; a natural-metaphor outcome, not an inner operation. It grounds the fret-not command (v1): do not envy what so soon withers. Standalone.

v36: 'though I SOUGHT (baqash) him, he could not be found' - the psalmist's searching for the once-flourishing wicked (v35) confirms his vanishing; the confirming search (cf 'look carefully' v10). The IB finding is the wicked's disappearance; this seeking is the observer's act. Standalone/qualifier of the vanishing wicked.
